doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Practice, the road and Dizzy's death
title: Carrying all his horns; fatigue and vertigo
summary: As a multi-instrumentalist he carries every horn himself, and fatigue and vertigo hit him when he is tired.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And unlike, for example, a trumpet player who, when everything is over, all he does is just like put his mouthpiece and his trumpet back in his gig bag, and that's all he's got to carry -­
-- you probably usually have, what? Your alto -­
-- you've got all these horns you're trying to carry.
Uh-huh. [affirmative] Because you definitely don't trust those to.

Nope! Nope. That's right. And -- and -- and I can tell when I'm more tired than others because sometimes it's heavier than what it is at other times, you know. I remember, I came home the other night and -- and I was rushing with my boy. He says, "Daddy." And I says, "Oh, man." And I can tell, you know. He could tell I was tired because he was wrestling and he could feel I'm not as strong, you know. If I'm rested, man, then I can -- he says, "Yeah, I can feel it, buddy." You know. You know? So. That's about the size -- and the nice thing is that most of all, my wife understands it now. 'Cause when I -- when we first married, I'd come home, "Oh, honey, let's go to the store and get this." And we'd be going different places and I'd be like this. You know, I'd be doing this. You know.

She didn't know. And then one day, she went with me. She came back, she says, "Honey, as soon as you get home, you're going to bed." Man, she had me up there in Seattle, I was going by to see my sister-in-law. Then I was going to see my mom and I do that, and I'd just come back from a tour, man, I was so tired, I tell ya, I couldn't see straight. Then, my vertigo. See, when I get real tired, the vertigo comes on me. You know. That came on me, man, the vertigo, I was, oh, man! I really needed a lot of sleep. Yeah.
